solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Most boisterous wife longs to break mould

indicators.note: one piece breaks another apart by sitting in the middle of it

parts.note: mould is rot, the fungal decay
to long for something is to be dying for it, so longs means dies

explanation.surface: A rowdy husband's partner yearns to escape the mould of convention.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mould' reads as a pattern to break free of, but it is the fungus; 'to break' means it is split around the other pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Rowdy describes noisy, disorderly behaviour, so the superlative is the most boisterous.

clue.text: Attacker one helping to support Resistance

indicators.note: in a down entry the supporting piece sits underneath the one it holds up

parts.note: R is the physics symbol for electrical resistance
someone who helps is an aider

explanation.surface: An assailant turns out to be a helper of the Resistance movement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to support' is a down-clue convention: AIDER sits below R, holding it up.
explanation.definitionFit: A raider is someone who makes a sudden assault, an attacker.

clue.text: Hard black blocks used to be bad for fitting

indicators.note: the pair stands in the way between two other pieces, blocking the gap

parts.note: used to be is the past tense was
a sin is something bad, so bad here gives A SIN
H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard
B is the pencil-grade abbreviation for black

explanation.surface: A dark, hard material that blocks something was once thought wrong for a fixture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blocks' sets HB between WAS and A SIN; 'bad' as 'a sin' is loose (it's a sin = it's bad).
explanation.definitionFit: A washbasin is a bathroom fixture, plumbed in, and fixtures and fittings go together in property terms.

clue.text: Progress initially awkward coming into trendy bars

parts.note: in means fashionable, trendy

indicators.note: one piece enters another, so it ends up inside

parts.note: rods are bars of metal or wood

indicators.note: initially means only the opening letter of the next word is used

explanation.surface: Early progress was clumsy when entering fashionable bars.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bars' suggests pubs, but here it means rods; 'coming into' and 'initially' are the two indicators.
explanation.definitionFit: To make inroads is to advance gradually into something, so inroads are progress.

clue.text: Million taken in an unspecified battle

indicators.note: one piece is taken inside another, enclosed by it

parts.note: some, as in 'some person', means one not named

explanation.surface: A million men were drawn into some battle nobody names.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken in' puts M inside SOME. The Somme was the 1916 First World War battle in northern France.
explanation.definitionFit: The Somme names the great 1916 Western Front offensive, a famous battle.

clue.text: Chicken a little tough

definitions.meaning: a small breed of domestic fowl
... also describes a small but combative person, as in bantamweight

explanation.surface: A chicken that's on the tough side.
explanation.definitionFit: Bantam is both a small chicken breed and a word for someone small but scrappy.

clue.text: This might make soccer player score, leap, cry

definitions.text: This might make soccer player score, leap, cry

parts.words: This might make soccer player score, leap, cry
parts.note: the letters of soccer player and score, leap, cry are exactly the same, so one rearrangement turns into the other

explanation.surface: Something that could make a footballer score, then jump and shout in joy.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as a goal celebration, but SOCCER PLAYER and SCORE LEAP CRY are rearrangements of one another.
explanation.definitionFit: A word or phrase formed by rearranging another's letters is exactly what the term names.

clue.text: Sort of cross having wasted chicken portion?

parts.note: a T is a cross shaped like the letter, a tau cross
wasted is slang for drugged, high

explanation.surface: A grumpy diner annoyed at a wasted portion of chicken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cross' looks like 'angry', but it is the shape T.
explanation.definitionFit: The thigh is a cut from the upper leg of a chicken; the question mark flags it as one example.

clue.text: Symbolic form amazingly apt in revamped Homer

indicators.note: one piece goes in the other, inside it
revamped means remade, so these letters are rebuilt in a new order
amazingly suggests something wild, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A symbolic device that fits surprisingly well in a reworked Homer epic.
explanation.walkthrough: Two separate anagrams: 'amazingly' works on the short word, 'revamped' on the poet's name, and 'in' places the first result inside the second.
explanation.definitionFit: A metaphor describes something as another thing it symbolises, a figure of speech.

clue.text: Child tracks men on foot

parts.note: an infant is a young child
RY is short for railway, a set of tracks

explanation.surface: A youngster follows the footprints of men walking.
explanation.definitionFit: Infantry are soldiers who fight on foot, as opposed to cavalry.

clue.text: Fan must start in line to see player

indicators.note: to fan is to spread out, so these letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: A fan must queue to get in and see a performer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fan' looks like the enthusiast in the queue; it is the anagram signal on MUST START IN LINE.
explanation.definitionFit: An instrumentalist plays a musical instrument, a player.

clue.text: Welcome the writer coming back to stay

indicators.note: coming back means these letters are read backwards

parts.note: the writer is the setter speaking of themself, me
a brace is a support or stay

explanation.surface: An author returns and is welcomed to stay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming back' turns ME into EM.
explanation.definitionFit: To embrace an idea or person is to accept them gladly, to welcome them.

clue.text: Zeppelin songs extremely cool

parts.note: airs are tunes or songs
hip means very fashionable, extremely cool

explanation.surface: Led Zeppelin's songs are seriously cool.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests the rock band Led Zeppelin; the definition is the German rigid airship.
explanation.definitionFit: A Zeppelin is a type of rigid dirigible named after Count Zeppelin, an airship.

clue.text: Easiest one to crack in my view

indicators.note: cracking something breaks it open, so these letters are broken and reassembled

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Personally, I think this is the easiest one to solve.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to crack' anagrams EASIEST together with I; the surface reads 'crack' as solve.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom expresses a personal opinion, the same as saying in my view.

clue.text: Sense agreement amongst rowing crew

indicators.note: amongst places one piece in the middle of another

parts.note: an eight is a boat crewed by eight rowers
yes is a word of agreement

explanation.surface: There is a feeling of consensus among the members of a rowing crew.
explanation.walkthrough: An eight is the standard racing boat with eight oarsmen and a cox, and 'amongst' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Sight is one of the five senses, and eyesight is that faculty.

clue.text: Saw to test on vehicle in front

indicators.note: in front means this piece goes before the one next to it

parts.note: the MOT is the annual roadworthiness test for British vehicles, named after the old Ministry of Transport

explanation.surface: Instructions to test a saw on the front of a vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like the cutting tool or the past of see; it is a noun meaning a saying.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying or proverb, and so is a motto.

clue.text: Bridged river that's risen about metre

indicators.note: about means going around, so one piece encloses the other
in a down entry, rising means reading upwards, so the word is reversed

parts.note: the Dart is a river in Devon, south-west England
metre is the rhythm of poetry, and verse is metrical writing

explanation.surface: A river has risen around a measuring point at a bridge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's risen' reads the river upwards to give TRAD, and 'about' wraps that round the poetry word.
explanation.definitionFit: To bridge a gap or river is to span it, and to traverse is to cross.

clue.text: Line up male actors in beach formation

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means read from the bottom, so the word is reversed

parts.note: a row is a line
the cast is the set of actors in a show

explanation.surface: A director lines up the male actors in formation on the beach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns ROW into WOR.
explanation.definitionFit: A wormcast is the coiled heap of sand that a lugworm leaves on a beach.

clue.text: Keeper having depressing experience first dropped

indicators.note: the opening letter of the word is taken away

parts.note: a downer is something depressing

explanation.surface: A goalkeeper has a gloomy experience after first dropping the ball.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first dropped' removes D from DOWNER.
explanation.definitionFit: An owner keeps possession of what they have; a pet's owner is its keeper.

clue.text: Rook loves hawk to destroy totally

parts.note: R is the chess abbreviation for rook
love is nil, zero in tennis, which looks like O, so two loves are OO
to hawk goods is to sell them by touting

explanation.surface: A rook adores hunting with a hawk to wipe out prey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rook' and 'hawk' look like birds; they are a chess piece and a verb for selling.
explanation.definitionFit: To root out is to eradicate something completely, destroying it utterly.

clue.text: African alien hides pain, meeting Scotsman

indicators.note: one piece hides another by enclosing it

parts.note: ET is the film alien
gyp is British slang for pain, as in 'my knee is giving me gyp'
Ian is a typically Scottish first name

explanation.surface: An extraterrestrial conceals his pain when he meets a Scot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hides' is the container signal; 'meeting' merely joins the Scotsman on the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Egypt lies in north-east Africa, so an Egyptian is an African.

clue.text: Interesting now hot Romeo coming out

indicators.note: one letter comes out, so it is removed from the word

parts.note: tropical weather is hot
Romeo is R in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A sexy Romeo announcing he is coming out is the current talk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming out' removes R from TROPICAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A topical subject concerns current affairs, so it is of interest at present.

clue.text: Against hoovers using bags

indicators.note: to bag is to hold inside, so the phrase contains the letters wanted

explanation.surface: An argument against using vacuum cleaners with bags.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bags' means the letters sit inside 'hoovers using'.
explanation.definitionFit: Versus, as in a match fixture, means against.

clue.text: Italian inventor has brandy on island

parts.note: marc is a brandy distilled from grape skins left after pressing

explanation.surface: An Italian inventor drinks brandy on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Guglielmo Marconi pioneered radio, an Italian engineer and inventor.

clue.text: Scoundrel giving up whiskey shows strain

indicators.note: the word gives up a letter, which is removed

parts.note: a wretch is a scoundrel
Whiskey is W in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A rogue going off whisky shows the strain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'giving up' removes W from WRETCH.
explanation.definitionFit: To retch is to heave or strain as if vomiting.

clue.text: Spend penny — allowed to go in river

indicators.note: these pieces go inside another one

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Wales and in Scotland
let means allowed

explanation.surface: Spend a penny, a British idiom for urinating, allowed in a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spend a penny' is British slang for using the toilet, which hides that 'Spend' alone is the definition; 'to go in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To deplete resources is to use them up, to spend them.

clue.text: Attractive little girl reticent

parts.note: Di is a short form of the girl's name Diana
shy means reticent

explanation.surface: A pretty young girl who is reserved.
explanation.definitionFit: Dishy is informal British for good-looking, attractive.

clue.text: Time aboard cosy starship is working for scientists

indicators.note: aboard means inside, so one piece is carried within another
working means put into operation, and these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Time on a comfortable spaceship does work for space scientists.
explanation.walkthrough: 'working' rearranges COSY STARSHIP IS; 'aboard' puts T inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Astrophysicists study the physics of stars and space, so they are scientists.

clue.text: Current that reverses around one Polynesian paradise

indicators.note: around means one piece goes round another
reverses means the word is read backwards

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
I is the physics symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: Its currents swirl around one tropical island paradise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reverses' turns THAT into TAHT; 'around' puts I inside; current's I goes at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Tahiti is an island in French Polynesia famed as an idyllic paradise.

clue.text: During travels notice region centred on Delos

indicators.note: during places one piece within the time span of another, inside it

parts.note: cycles are travels by bicycle
an ad is a notice advertising something

explanation.surface: While touring, you notice an area around the island of Delos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'travels' means bike rides here, and 'During' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The Cyclades are the Greek Aegean islands arranged in a ring around Delos.
